query: A framework agreement will enable agencies to procure approved IaaS, PaaS and SaaS services.
Cloud contracts will define availability, support, audit rights and shared security responsibilities.
Tagging, budgets and FinOps controls will monitor and optimise cloud consumption.
Providers will be accredited against government cloud assurance requirements.
Contracts will require export in open formats, transition assistance and verified deletion.
The project will put in place arrangements for government agencies to procure, pay for and manage cloud services.
